labels.x: Policy minus Sublet in the same week
labels.caption: Sublet against the stronger baselines on weeks 101 (1 week, policy seed 0): the paired margin, a policy's cost minus Sublet's in the same week (positive: Sublet costs less), of (a)~$r_0$ under the trace lender L-tr, (b)~$W_0$, the largest $r_0$ over the five stress lenders of the confirmation, and (c)~$W_0^{+}$, the largest over these and the six new ones (the adaptive lender through its equivalence with the eager lender). Markers: medians over the weeks; bars: min--max; the vertical line is Sublet. Each $x$ axis is linear within $\pm$0.1 and logarithmic beyond. In a row of two rules the upper marker is the first rule and the lower its variant, with an arrow from the first to the second where the two are apart: five primary baselines as built to their transplants of Algorithm~2's base contract $\bar k$; SpotHedge-style with spares per pool to spares per LLM, none while idle, with $\bar k$. MPC is drawn at the setting of rule T and, in its own row, the oracle forecast at MPC's as-built setting, a lookahead reference that no comparison set holds and that ran under L-tr and L-hon only. Every policy's values: Tables~\ref{tab:e7r-tags} and \ref{tab:e7r-margins}.
